concerns.text: No task explicitly ingests the required `data/processed/subgraph.parquet` file as mandated by FR-001. T005 implements a streaming fetcher from OpenAlex instead of reading the local parquet source, leaving the specification’s data‑source contract uncovered.
SC‑001 (schema‑validation error rate) is not measured or recorded by any task. Existing tasks validate data but never compute or assert a zero‑error rate metric.
SC‑002 (novelty‑score variance) is absent; no task computes or logs `novelty_score_variance` required to confirm independence from topology.
SC‑003 (regression R‑squared improvement over a baseline) is not addressed. T014 runs a Negative‑Binomial GLM but does not produce a baseline model comparison or an R‑squared improvement metric.
